mods.description: Shows a targeted player's live ping after you hit them, with a customizable HUD.

releases.notes:
Player Ping Display **1.2.0** for Fabric Minecraft **1.21.4**.

**[Download playerpingdisplay-1.2.0+mc1.21.4.jar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/augumental/playerpingdisplay/downloads-1.2.0/playerpingdisplay-1.2.0%2Bmc1.21.4.jar)**

This direct GitHub download works in your browser. Replace the older Player Ping Display jar in your client mods folder with this jar. Install only the jar matching your Minecraft version.

Requires Fabric Loader **0.19.3 or newer**, Java **21**, and Fabric API **0.119.4+1.21.4**. Mod Menu is optional.

Press **U** in-game to open settings. Reset the mod's binding in Controls if an older installation still has it unbound. Click and drag the live preview in settings to move the HUD.

Includes font choices, ping colors with RGB sliders/swatches, text shadow, rounded corners, display duration, HUD scale, background color/opacity/padding, and editable %player% / %ping% formats with presets. Settings save automatically and old configurations migrate.

Validation: all ten versions passed clean builds and real-client checks locally and across GitHub Actions runs. The linked jar was downloaded and its SHA-256 verified: `4ecce359e121923161e82a506c64ae3b14689b9ccb611d5cbd8e407a9e9ed206`. Live multiplayer ping still needs a gameplay check.

Preview of PR #2; source changes are not merged yet.

releases.notes:
Fabric port of Player Ping Display 1.0.6 for **Minecraft 1.21.1**. Preserves the five-second ping display, live refresh, lookup modes, fade/colors, HUD positioning, settings, and existing config files.

Installation:

- Download `playerpingdisplay-1.0.6+mc1.21.1.jar` below and put it in your client's `mods` folder.
- Use Minecraft **1.21.1**, Java **21**, Fabric Loader **0.19.5 or newer**, and Fabric API **0.116.17+1.21.1**.
- Mod Menu **11.0.5** is optional. You can also assign the configuration key in Controls.
- Install only the jar matching your Minecraft version. This mod is client-only.

Validation: clean build, GitHub CI, client startup, settings rendering, config migration/persistence, reset, and Mod Menu integration passed. Live multiplayer ping behavior has not been tested.
